name: Analysis panel contains at least three paragraphs
description: The analysis content for a match should have at least three separate paragraphs of text, providing enough depth to cover different aspects of the match.

planSteps.description: Click on a bracket match cell to open a match detail page
Click the Analysis tab or section control
Scroll down within the analysis panel to reveal all content
Verify the analysis panel contains at least 3 distinct paragraph blocks of text content. Count visible text paragraphs separated by whitespace or paragraph breaks.
